events.text_en: Cơ Châu Lệ, who changed her name to the burned harbour's, lights the first lamp of Vọng Triều Đường above the piers and sets a keeper in the empty fort of Liệu Phàm Bảo.
Dịch Thủy Thanh of Vọng Triều drowns at the Kim Sa lamp in the storm tide; the lamp has burned low.
Ôn Thủ Đăng writes the Last Lamp Vigil.
Chân Định Lan of Vọng Triều wards the palace's jetty at Thạch Cơ Thành alone by night; the storm cracks it anyway.
